fields.label: Environment
fields.description: Demo and live are different accounts with different tokens. Defaulting to demo is deliberate: a mis-set environment must fail towards the account with no money in it.

fields.label: cTrader Account ID
fields.description: The trading account the tokens authorise. Not a secret — it is shown back to the user so they can confirm which account is connected.

fields.label: Account Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code the broker account is denominated in. Every balance, equity, P/L and margin figure the dashboard reports is in this currency, and rforex.margin refuses to compute a snapshot without it — an amount whose currency was not recorded cannot be recovered afterwards.

fields.label: OAuth Tokens
fields.description: Password fieldtype: values live in Frappe's __Auth table, not in this DocType's own table, and are readable only through doc.get_password(). permlevel 1 keeps them out of the owner's own reads as well — see the module docstring for why this is stricter than the Saved Card precedent.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: Never returned by any whitelisted method. Read server-side with doc.get_password('access_token').

fields.label: Refresh Token
fields.description: Never returned by any whitelisted method. Longer-lived than the access token and therefore worse to leak.

fields.label: Access Token Expires At
fields.description: Not a secret. Returned to the client so the app can show 'reconnect' before a trade fails rather than after.

fields.label: Granted Scope
fields.description: What the user actually authorised. Recorded so a scope narrower than the bot needs is diagnosable without re-running the OAuth flow.
